label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: The claim implies a no-harm standard, but the report records 29 total recordable injuries, 2 lost time injuries, and 1 case of work-related ill-health in FY25.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that all activities are undertaken without compromising health and safety and that no injury or harm is acceptable (implying prevention/zero harm in practice). The provided evidence only reports outcomes—29 total recordable injuries, 2 lost time injuries, and 1 recordable case of work-related ill-health—and does not substantiate that activities were undertaken without compromising health and safety. In fact, the reported injuries and ill-health indicate harm occurred, and there is no evidence of a zero-injury/zero-harm result, nor any supporting details (policies, controls, performance trend, scope/timeframe) that would materially verify the claim as written.
